title: Valuation Statement for HostCover Valuables Claims (Art, Jewellery, Collectibles)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) valuables settlement: the figure the host is offered on an approved valuables claim.**

The valuables settlement starts from the loss the claims team verified on the approved valuables claim. A stay bears its deductible once: each claim of the stay that already carries a reimbursement has borne an equal share of it, that share being the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the stay, and the valuables claim bears the part of the level's deductible those reimbursed claims have not borne. From the verified valuables loss, every guest payment recorded on the valuables claim, net of reversals, is subtracted together with the deductible the valuables claim bears. The result is floored at 0.00 and then cut to the lowest of the level's valuables sublimit, the level's per-claim limit and the plan's remaining aggregate, which is the level's annual aggregate limit less the reimbursements, net of recoveries, posted on the plan in the current plan year. The valuables settlement is rounded half up to the nearest cent only at the end.

## The deductible the valuables claim bears

The deductible borne by the valuables claim equals the level's deductible multiplied by the number of approved claims on the stay not yet carrying a reimbursement, divided by the number of approved claims on the stay. A claim counts as carrying a reimbursement when the plan's HostCover ledger shows a reimbursement on it.

| Approved claims on the stay (hypothetical level deductible 300.00) | Of which already reimbursed | Deductible the valuables claim bears |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (the valuables claim alone) | 0 | 300.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 300.00 |
| 2 | 1 | 150.00 |
| 3 | 1 | 200.00 |
| 3 | 2 | 100.00 |

## Worked statement (hypothetical inputs, not the figures of any level)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Verified valuables loss | 3000.00 |
| Deductible borne (3 approved claims on the stay, 1 reimbursed, level deductible 300.00) | 200.00 |
| Guest payments on the valuables claim, net of reversals | 150.00 |
| Net valuables loss: 3000.00 less 200.00 less 150.00 | 2650.00 |
| Remaining aggregate: limit 40000.00 less reimbursements net of recoveries this plan year 12000.00 | 28000.00 |
| Ceiling: lowest of valuables sublimit 4000.00, per-claim limit 20000.00 and 28000.00 | 4000.00 |
| Valuables settlement, rounded half up to the cent | 2650.00 |
